face_design.hair_why: ‘single white feather’·몸 형태 wings에서 끝을 가볍게 친 페더컷(층 낸 컷) · 긴 머리 · 한쪽 눈을 덮는 긴 사이드뱅 — 빼미스로우에서 이어 같은 묶음
hair_cues: ‘single white feather’ → 헤어스타일 끝을 가볍게 친 페더컷
고스트 타입 → 앞머리 한쪽 눈을 덮는 긴 사이드뱅

final_face_line: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): elongated face, long length, narrow width; long chin with defined jaw; narrow eyes, medium size, level outer corners, average spacing; straight medium brows; aquiline nose with convex bridge; small mouth.
comparison: Decidueye has a long narrow jaw and chin, level narrow visible eye and small mouth; Rowlet has a short round cheek shape, Dartrix an intermediate oval face, Lilligant a wider forehead and softer taper. Hair/ornament color was not used as the only distinguishing feature.
correction: Sixth digit on screen-left open glove; local hand-only edit before locking corrected light as final anchor.

features.detail: two backward, and short dark green talons
